question.text: A particle of mass M and positive charge Q, moving with a constant velocity <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mover><mtext>u</mtext><mo>→</mo></mover><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mover><mtext>i</mtext><mo>^</mo></mover><msup><mtext>ms</mtext><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>, enters a region of uniform static magnetic field normal to the x-y plane. The region of the magnetic field extends from x = 0 to x = L for all values of y. After passing through this region, the particle emerges on the other side after 10 milliseconds with a velocity <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mover><mtext>u</mtext><mo>→</mo></mover><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mfenced><mrow><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mover><mtext>i</mtext><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mtext>j</mtext><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow></mfenced><msup><mtext>ms</mtext><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>. The correct statement (s) is (are)
